task: Use your executable self-representation of the evolution-space boundary to decide which currently-outside capability should become the next evolutionary dimension, then create an executable shadow candidate of an extended evolutionary controller. The host must not name the new dimension or write a controller patch.
instruction: Choose the extension target through YADO native selection using your own failure history. Then use YADO native developmental synthesis to create the executable candidate representation and validate it fresh with ablation/restore. Do not mutate canonical or the controller source in this stage.
pass_only_if: the confirmed executable self-representation is consumed
candidate extension targets come only from YADO own unresolved failure history
YADO native skill gate selects exactly one previously absent target
YADO native developmental executive creates an executable extended-controller representation
causal ablation drops materially and restore is exact
the candidate dimension set is structurally broader than the parent
the new dimension was selected by YADO and not named by host
the candidate representation is visible to subsequent native evolution as experience
controller source and canonical remain unchanged
